YOLOX-Tiny object detector, trained on COCO.

Source: https://github.com/Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX
Model: https://github.com/Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX/releases/download/0.1.1rc0/yolox_tiny.onnx

Used unmodified by Assets/Scripts/CatVision.cs to find the cat in the webcam feed.
